rules: A cohort is an accounting/history structure, not a promise that every member follows identical academic outcomes.
Retakes, delayed progression, withdrawal or other exceptions require explicit state/events rather than silent cohort reshuffling.
A cadet cannot occupy two current cadet-class memberships simultaneously.
Field training or temporary leave changes presence, not cohort membership.
Graduation/commission removes the cadet from active Academy cadet population through an explicit transition.
Cohort membership history remains after graduation or departure.
